claims.statement: For symmetric n and a with n a=0, the invariant orthonormal spatial frame has Ric_ii=[n_i^2-(n_j-n_k)^2]/2-2a^2, Ric_23=a(n_2-n_3), Ric_12=Ric_13=0 in the diagonal n, a=(a,0,0) gauge.
The six displayed I, II, IX, V and VII0 Ricci matrices follow from D1-curvature; flat VII0 and I give an intrinsically Euclidean local slice with different simply transitive presentations.
evidence: Ellis et al. Relativistic Cosmology Table 18.1-18.2
